title: 第204章 有区别吗第203章 心剑合一
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
....
简单来说，剑意也是可以划分层次的。
如一重剑意外放，有其状，二重剑意锋芒毕露，有其势，三重剑意内敛，含而不发。
然后是四重剑意化形，剑意可凝聚成任何形状。
再之后就是重剑意通神，剑意可伤神魂，剑意归真，剑意即法则，法则即剑意等...
当初，左丘辰在突破剑尊时，剑意便达到了第三重内敛之境。
这三日的磨砺，让他的剑意突破到了第四重，就已经介于内敛与化形之间...
“要在万妖台大比前达到第五重剑意化形，还需要更多的磨砺。”
顿时，他闭上眼睛，再次一剑一剑地刺出。
而塔中无岁月...
故此，左丘辰在本源塔中修炼了整整一个月。
当下，塔中一个月，外界不过数个时辰。
这一个月里，他将准帝初期的修为彻底巩固。
然后，五行生死印从雏形打磨到小成，剑意从第四重突破到第五重化形之境。
甚至，神魂壁垒在混沌雷劫的淬炼下虽然层数未增，但每一层的强度都提升到了新的层次...
当然，更重要的是，他开始修炼神魂之剑！
神魂之剑，是以神魂之力凝聚成剑，专攻对方神魂。
好家伙，这种攻击手段无形无质，防不胜防，是剑尊五重以上才能修炼的神通。
但是，左丘辰用了整整十天。
而塔中十天这才勉强凝聚出第一柄神魂之剑的雏形...

嗡！
只见，那是一柄只有三寸长的透明小剑，悬浮在他的神魂空间中。
仔细看去，剑身上没有任何法则纹路，只有最纯粹的神魂之力...
“神魂之剑，去！”
嗤！
顿时，他心念一动，那柄三寸小剑从眉心射出，穿透了本源塔的层层空间，斩在塔外一座无人荒山的山体上。
下一刻，没有声音，没有震动，甚至连一丝法则波动都没有。
但那座荒山的山体内部，一块拳头大小的岩石无声无息地化作了齑粉。
不是被力量碾碎的，而是被神魂之剑斩灭了岩石中蕴含的存在本身...
“好霸道的神魂之剑。”
见此，左丘辰微微咂舌。
content_en:
....
To put it simply, sword intent can also be divided into levels.
Just like a heavy sword accidentally released, it has its shape. The second sword's intention is sharp and has its power. The third sword's intention is restrained and contained but not released.
Then there is the transformation of the fourfold sword intention. The sword intention can be condensed into any shape.
After that, the sword's intention can connect to the gods, the sword's intention can hurt the soul, the sword's intention can return to its true form, the sword's intention is the law, the law is the sword's intention, etc...
When Zuo Qiuchen broke through the Sword Master, his sword intention reached the third level of restraint.
After three days of training, his sword intention has reached the fourth level, which is between restraint and transformation...
"To reach the fifth level of Sword Intent Transformation before the Ten Thousand Demons Competition, more training is needed."
Immediately, he closed his eyes and thrust out his sword one after another.
But there is no time in the tower...
Therefore, Zuo Qiuchen practiced in the Origin Tower for a whole month.
At the moment, there is only one month in the tower and only a few hours outside.
In this month, he completely consolidated the early cultivation level of the Quasi-Emperor.
Then, the Five Elements Seal of Life and Death was polished from prototype to completion, and the sword intention broke through from the fourth level to the fifth level of transformation.
Even though the number of layers of the Divine Soul Barrier has not increased due to the tempering of the Chaos Thunder Tribulation, the strength of each layer has been raised to a new level...
Of course, more importantly, he started practicing the Soul Sword!
The sword of the soul is a sword condensed with the power of the soul, which specializes in attacking the opponent's soul.
Good guy, this kind of attack is intangible and hard to defend against. It is a magical power that can only be cultivated by the Sword Master at level 5 or above.
However, Zuo Qiuchen spent ten days.
And it took ten days in the tower to barely condense the prototype of the first divine soul sword...
Buzz!
He saw that it was a small transparent sword only three inches long, suspended in his soul space.
Looking carefully, there are no legal patterns on the sword, only the purest power of the soul...
"Sword of the Soul, go!"
Tsk!
Suddenly, with a thought in his mind, the small three-inch sword shot out from between his eyebrows, penetrated the layers of space of the Origin Tower, and struck an uninhabited mountain outside the tower.
The next moment, there was no sound, no vibration, not even a trace of law fluctuation.
But inside the barren mountain, a fist-sized rock turned into powder silently.
It was not crushed by power, but the existence itself contained in the rock was destroyed by the sword of the soul...
"What a domineering sword of the soul."
Seeing this, Zuo Qiuchen clicked his tongue slightly.
